title: Koala with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="26" ry="16" fill="#a8bcd0"/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx="26" cy="78" rx="8" ry="11" fill="#98acc0" transform="rotate(-20 26 78)"/>
